data_objects.name: shellfish_specimens
data_objects.meaning: Individual shellfish specimen measurements covering body dimensions, component weights, sex or development code, and shell-ring count.
data_objects.notes: No explicit specimen identifier is present.

variables.name: Sex
variables.meaning: Sex or developmental category encoded with the labels M, F, and I.

variables.name: Shucked weight
variables.meaning: Weight of the shucked edible or body portion.

variables.name: Rings
variables.meaning: Count of growth rings observed on the shell.

structure.description: Each row represents one specimen; the table has no source identifier or temporal ordering field.
Sex is a categorical code, dimensions are continuous measurements, component weights partition aspects of specimen mass, and Rings is an integer count.

uncertainties: The organism name is not explicitly supplied; the shellfish interpretation is inferred from the joint measurement vocabulary.
The definitions of M, F, and I are not provided, so I cannot be conclusively expanded beyond sex or developmental categories.
Units and any normalization of the dimension and weight fields are not stated.
annotation_notes: The semantic map is based only on train.csv and leaves measurement units null where the source provides none.
